card.name: Quantities in recipe ingredient lists
card.fires_on: Amounts and unit words in cooking ingredient lists, such as the number 1 or 2 before tsp, Tbsp or cup, and the unit itself (c, cup, tsp). It fires where an ingredient line begins or the measure is being written.

modes.label: Leading number
modes.description: The digit starting an ingredient line, just before a spoon or cup unit.
modes.example: 1 Tbsp. canola oil 1 (15-ounce) can kidney beans <<1>> cup corn (canned or frozen)

modes.label: Kitchen unit word
modes.description: The unit abbreviation or word after a fraction or number in a recipe.

card.plain: It marks the amount-and-measure part of a recipe's ingredient list, like 1 cup or 1/4 tsp.
